requirements.statement: Material decisions, assumptions, risks, unknowns, exceptions, and waivers shall have stable IDs, owners, evidence, impact, status, review triggers, and expiry where applicable.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Owner input shall be requested only for material legal/commercial authority, credentials, recurring cost, broad permissions, external publication, destructive action, or irreversible architecture that cannot be derived safely.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Unknown or contradictory evidence shall remain visible and shall block only the affected scope unless propagation is proven.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
